firstPlayerRule: Decide who will play the Editor and Nixon roles. Setup points the initiative card toward the Editor, so the Editor plays the first card.
clarifications: The booklet does not specify how the two people should choose their roles.
This opening applies to the initial card phase; later initiative can change.
